_note: The flags registry (10-06, the 8-bit battle lane §2.8): every flag the game sets or reads, one line each. tools/compile.py refuses a flag not named here (tools/flags.py). A new flag: add its line. A family (a name with a colon) is checked by its prefix.

families.cocoon:: a cocoon in the nest cut down (cocoon:<x>,<y>; js/deep.js S.cocoon)
families.heard:: a rumour heard (content/rumors.json ids; js/events.js EV.dialog, the rumour table)
families.hex:: a Hex card or fight done (hex:<id>; js/events.js)
families.q:: a mission seen in the JOURNAL, its card shown (q:<quest id>; deep16/js/hours.js H16.missionCard, 10-28)
families.bread:: Aldwin's bread line given, that morning (bread:<day>; deep16/js/hours.js C.SCRIPTS.chapel, 10-28)
families.work:: a place Finding Work names, heard (work:winters|board|cradles|slate; deep16/js/counter.js C.flagOn, deep16/js/hours.js, 10-28)
families.rumorIdx:: how far down an NPC's rumours the party has heard (rumorIdx:<npc>; js/events.js)
families.said:: a talk branch said once (said:<npc>:<branch>; js/events.js EV.dialog)
families.trig:: a trigger that fires once, fired (trig:<trigger id>; js/world.js Field.arrive / use)
